mapper.sql: n.id, n.node_id, n.node_name, n.node_type, CASE n.node_type WHEN 1 THEN '科室' WHEN 2 THEN '仓库' ELSE '未知' END AS node_type_name, n.parent_node_id, pn.node_name AS parent_node_name, n.warehouse_type, CASE n.warehouse_type WHEN 1 THEN '中心库' WHEN 2 THEN '科室库' WHEN 3 THEN '临时库' ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_type_name, n.warehouse_status, CASE n.warehouse_status WHEN 1 THEN '启用' WHEN 0 THEN '禁用' ELSE NULL END AS warehouse_status_name, n.dept_status, CASE n.dept_status WHEN 1 THEN '启用' WHEN 0 THEN '禁用' ELSE NULL END AS dept_status_name, n.tenant_id, n.del_flag, n.create_by, n.create_time, n.update_by, n.update_time
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM spd_org_node n LEFT JOIN spd_org_node pn ON n.parent_node_id = pn.node_id AND pn.del_flag = 0 WHERE n.node_type = 1 AND n.dept_status = 1 AND n.del_flag = #{delFlag} AND n.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY n.node_name ASC

SELECT
FROM spd_org_node n LEFT JOIN spd_org_node pn ON n.parent_node_id = pn.node_id AND pn.del_flag = 0 WHERE n.node_type = 2 AND n.warehouse_status = 1 AND n.del_flag = #{delFlag} AND n.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY n.node_name ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE spd_org_node SET del_flag = #{delFlag}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{nodeId}
UPDATE spd_org_node SET warehouse_status = #{warehouseStatus}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{nodeId} AND node_type = 2
UPDATE spd_org_node SET dept_status = #{deptStatus}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{nodeId} AND node_type = 1
